# Goose — Agent Efficiency
Derived from the `gen_ai` span tree: `invoke_agent → chat → execute_tool`. Per-tool latency, model attribution and session flow via `gen_ai.conversation.id`.

> Percentiles here come from **span durations** (raw spans), since Goose emits no latency histograms.

**Per-role breakdown.** When the BMAD crew runs ACP-deployed (`recipes/bmad/` + `k8s/goose/bmad/`), each role sets its own `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` (`goose-conductor`, `goose-researcher`, `goose-planner`, `goose-executor`, `goose-reviewer`), surfaced here as `service.name`. Use the **service** variable to isolate a role. The *Trace composition* tile below is the single-trace check: a trace whose `role_count > 1` means the Conductor forwarded the W3C `traceparent` across the ACP hop, so the whole crew run is ONE distributed trace. On the pinned Goose **v1.46.0** each role is its own trace (`role_count == 1`) — see `docs/observability.md` §6 and README §7 fallback stance.

1.title: p95 span duration by operation
1.query: fetch spans | filter isNotNull(gen_ai.operation.name) | summarize p95 = percentile(duration, 95), by:{ gen_ai.operation.name }

2.title: execute_tool latency over time (p50 / p95)
2.query: fetch spans | filter gen_ai.operation.name == "execute_tool" | makeTimeseries { p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95) }

3.title: Calls by model
3.query: fetch spans | filter isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) | summarize calls = count(), by:{ gen_ai.request.model }

4.title: Tool invocations by name and role
4.query: fetch spans | filter gen_ai.operation.name == "execute_tool" | summarize calls = count(), by:{ tool.name, service.name } | sort calls desc | limit 20

5.title: Recent sessions (conversation flow)
5.query: fetch spans | filter isNotNull(gen_ai.conversation.id) | summarize spans = count(), duration = sum(duration), by:{ gen_ai.conversation.id } | sort duration desc | limit 20

6.title: p95 span duration by role (OTEL_SERVICE_NAME)
6.query: fetch spans | filter isNotNull(service.name) | summarize p95 = percentile(duration, 95), spans = count(), by:{ service.name } | sort p95 desc

7.title: Trace composition — roles per trace (single-trace check)
7.query: fetch spans | filter isNotNull(trace.id) and isNotNull(service.name) | summarize roles = collectDistinct(service.name), spans = count(), by:{ trace.id } | fieldsAdd role_count = arraySize(roles) | sort role_count desc, spans desc | limit 20
